heading: Compare data providers by workflow
description: Invariant Earth connects property, infrastructure and environmental records through one API. Use these tests to compare it with specialist tools and public data sources on the same sites and dates.

workflows.title: Parcel boundaries and ownership
workflows.test: Give each provider the same Manhattan condo address and unit. Ask for the base lot, the billing lot, the unit identifier and the record behind the geometry.

workflows.title: Location data and property screening
workflows.test: Check the address point and whole parcel at Brooklyn Army Terminal. Ask the provider to identify which geometry it tested and report the share of the lot in Zone AE.

workflows.title: GIS APIs for land and site selection
workflows.test: Start with a polygon that crosses parcel lines. Check what the API matches, which fields come back unknown and whether you can export the geometry and its source.

workflows.title: GIS MCP servers and mapping agents
workflows.test: Give an AI agent a U.S. address and a date. Check whether it returns the parcel, its geometry and a link to the original source. Use the tool response to verify data vintage and provenance.

workflows.title: Building footprints and property details
workflows.test: Use an address shared by multiple buildings. Require separate footprints and IDs, then verify which footprint area belongs to each building and how it was measured.

workflows.title: Building permits and inspection history
workflows.test: Use one work permit that appears in two trade rows. Ask for the permit number, inspection status and earlier expiration date, with the source for each field.

workflows.title: Contractor permit history and activity
workflows.test: Look up NYC license GC 002305. Ask for the original work permit numbers, sequences and work types. Compare the count of first issuances with the number of permits that have any issue activity.

workflows.title: Entitlements, moratoria and local opposition
workflows.test: For the East Palatka proposal, trace the hearing, adopted decision and conditions. Check which development phase the wastewater and electric service evidence applies to.

workflows.title: Data center zoning and special use permits
workflows.test: Find Hornbaker Road by county parcel ID. Recover the rezoning and special use decision separately, and show which map and ordinance date govern the overlay answer.

workflows.title: Zoning and permitted uses
workflows.test: At 2239 Forest Avenue, compare the zoning at the address point with the districts that intersect the tax lot. Ask for the code, geometry and date that support the permitted use.

workflows.title: Environmental records and Phase I screening
workflows.test: Run the Gowanus Canal case with a point search and a footprint intersection. Trace cleanup milestones to the original documents and ask which historical records the vendor supplies for Phase I work.

workflows.title: Commercial lending and collateral diligence
workflows.test: Replay two review dates for the same collateral. Distinguish the signing date, recorder date and date the vendor observed the filing. Check the property identifier against each document.

workflows.title: Commercial foreclosure, recorded conveyances and court notices
workflows.test: At 701 Seventh Avenue, match BBL 1010000001 to case 850272/2019. Keep the leasehold auction, recorder amount and separate fee-interest CMBS reporting in different fields.

workflows.title: Deeds, LLCs and ownership networks
workflows.test: Choose an LLC with a similar name in another state. Require the recorded deed, the entity jurisdiction and the evidence that links the company to this asset.

workflows.title: CMBS, loan maturity and collateral monitoring
workflows.test: Test a loan whose maturity changed. Ask for the scheduled date, any optional extension and the filing that shows whether that extension took effect.

workflows.title: Commercial sales, leases and comparables
workflows.test: At 32 Old Slip, ask for source-backed sale and lease figures. Check the interest transferred and how the vendor treats serviced rent, fixed rent and floor area.

workflows.title: Commercial property insurance underwriting
workflows.test: Send a statement of values for two buildings on one tax lot. Request the building match and sources for construction, occupancy, roof and hazard data. Track which fields need manual review.

workflows.title: Roof age and replacement evidence
workflows.test: Use the Rosemead roof project and a June 30 quote date. Request the imagery date and any documentary evidence of completion. Check when the evidence was available to the underwriter.

workflows.title: Flood risk and catastrophe exposure
workflows.test: Choose a building, address and parcel that yield different flood zone results. Ask for the FEMA panel and effective date, plus the model version for any estimated flood depth.

workflows.title: Hail history and weather verification
workflows.test: Check neighboring sites on the same storm date. Require the measuring station or data grid, the observation time and the source of the estimate before attributing damage to a building.

workflows.title: Powered land and data center power studies
workflows.test: Give each provider the same 200 MW ramp schedule and candidate connections. Request the power-flow assumptions, binding equipment, outage cases and upgrades. Ask for the utility record behind any service date.

workflows.title: Data center site selection platforms and advisors
workflows.test: Use the same site, load phases and dates. Ask how a shortlist turns into a utility application or land decision. At Plaza 500, recover the 176 MW request, the order’s deadlines and the utility’s separate schedule.

workflows.title: Data centers for sale, powered shells and powered land marketplaces
workflows.test: Ask for a U.S. facility for purchase with at least 10 MW of existing gross utility service. Open each offer and compare the original MW, status and first date of service. Require utility and transfer evidence before treating a listing as buyer-ready.

workflows.title: Substation, feeder and grid capacity data
workflows.test: Use the same feeder ID at summer and winter peak. Ask for load headroom, the limiting element, the units and the model date. Request generation hosting capacity separately.

workflows.title: Solar and storage site selection
workflows.test: Ask for the candidate connection’s queue stage and the study underlying upgrade costs. Compare usable acreage after removing wetland, slope and setback constraints.

workflows.title: EV charging and fleet mobility data
workflows.test: Look up the same two charging stations. Compare installed fast-charge ports, enabled connectors and live status. Require timestamps and network coverage for live results.

workflows.title: Commercial EV charging rates and electricity costs
workflows.test: Replay 36,000 kWh under PG&E’s March 2026 BEV-2-S terms. Reproduce the energy, subscription and overage line items from the same 15-minute profiles.

workflows.title: Industrial logistics and truck routing
workflows.test: Route the same truck to a specific loading entrance. Supply height, weight and departure date, then check the last mile against adopted routes and bridge restrictions.

workflows.title: Truck traffic volume and AADT by road segment
workflows.test: Compare both sides of 85th Avenue North at Zane Avenue. Return the same traffic year, exact segment, all-vehicle denominator, truck class and direction. Keep probe volume and survey counts distinguishable.

workflows.title: Retail trade areas, foot traffic and consumer demand
workflows.test: For two stores, ask for each trade area boundary, the visit measurement window and households served only by the proposed location. Check how sampling and missing businesses are handled.

workflows.title: Business fiber and telecom serviceability
workflows.test: Use a multi-tenant building and check the suite address. Request the carrier, technology and installation terms. For redundant service, request separate entrance, conduit and route evidence.

workflows.title: Fiber maps and carrier route screening
workflows.test: Use the same building and proposed handoff. Check whether the result shows proximity, a candidate path, or written service evidence for the proposed circuit. Record who confirms the local connection and the date.

workflows.title: Cloud interconnect and peering redundancy
workflows.test: Compare the named AWS location for Equinix NY4 and NY5, the two Google Cloud edge domains at Equinix DA1, and the two Azure New York Metro peering locations. Ask for the ordered cloud endpoints and the evidence for independent physical access paths.

workflows.title: Aerial imagery and developable terrain
workflows.test: Ask for the acquisition date and image footprint over a parcel. For a slope screen, check the LiDAR vintage, ground resolution and vertical datum before measuring buildable acres.

workflows.title: Elevation APIs and terrain models
workflows.test: Look up one confirmed address point. Compare the physical surface, coordinate, raster resolution, vertical datum and source date before joining the values to a parcel decision.

workflows.title: Air quality and facility emissions
workflows.test: Compare a modeled address result with the nearest station on the same day. Require pollutant, units, time basis and station ID. Separately request the facility emissions reporting year.

workflows.title: Government contract awards and project signals
workflows.test: Follow an infrastructure project from the solicitation to the award and a subsequent modification. Check the IDs that link the records and the source for the amount actually obligated.

workflows.title: Farmland history and crop monitoring
workflows.test: Use the same field boundary for three crop years. Record the classification resolution and capture season. Compare soil moisture and crop history separately before drawing a conclusion about productivity.

workflows.title: Industrial land for sale and site availability
workflows.test: Search for at least 100 contiguous buildable acres for purchase. Ask which parcels are currently offered, how much land remains after setbacks and constraints, and who can confirm the terms.

workflows.title: City-owned land listings and parcel groups
workflows.test: Give each provider the four South Indiana Avenue PINs and the city’s November 25 inventory date. Require the grouped offering, the deadline, the dated land-value field and the actual application link.

workflows.title: Water and sewer service for a project
workflows.test: Use a parcel next to a mapped service boundary. Ask for separate water and sewer providers and the dated record supporting any treatment or connection capacity.

workflows.title: Water supply, withdrawals and allocation
workflows.test: Ask for the latest reported withdrawals and the period and geography they cover. Separately identify the permit, utility commitment or other record that could support a particular allocation.

workflows.title: Wetlands, soils and buildable land
workflows.test: Measure mapped wetlands and hydric soils inside the same parcel. Require layer vintages and units, then identify the field delineation or jurisdictional determination needed for design.

workflows.title: Hourly weather and climate for engineering
workflows.test: Request dry-bulb and dew point for the same site and year. Compare stations and gridded estimates, then check missing hours and time zones before estimating cooling conditions.

workflows.title: Population, employment and market demographics
workflows.test: Use the same trade area and reference year. Ask for household residents and daytime workers separately, and check how census blocks are assigned at the boundary.

workflows.title: Labor sheds, occupation wages and workplace access
workflows.test: For three Dayton workplace counties, reproduce the 116,658 primary jobs with homes outside the metro. Then test a specific facility entrance and preserve the differences between existing jobs, reachable residents and applicants.

workflows.title: Industrial employment and economic signals
workflows.test: Compare three counties for the same manufacturing industry and quarter. Check that totals use the same industry classification, geography and employment concept. Preserve suppressed values as unknown.

workflows.title: Property tax history and assessments
workflows.test: Retrieve three years for one commercial parcel. Separate market value, taxable assessed value, exemptions and the actual bill. Check how the provider treats a parcel ID change.

workflows.title: Construction leads and planned developments
workflows.test: Find W-951R and S-20057 by contract ID. Separate bid deadlines, award filing, ratification, rejection and a planned successor. Check the original records for a proposed open bid.

workflows.title: Electricity prices, load and demand
workflows.test: Compare prices for the same ERCOT settlement point and operating interval. Keep day-ahead and real-time series separate, then check handling of revisions and daylight saving time.

workflows.title: ERCOT nodal and settlement price data
workflows.test: Replay delivery hour 19, interval 3 on November 25, 2026. Ask the provider to return West Hub and West Load Zone as separate settlement points and explain the applicable time and price series.

workflows.title: Schools, hospitals and emergency service areas
workflows.test: Check a parcel near a district boundary. Request the assigned school, the responsible emergency service and a routed trip to the relevant hospital as three separate results.

workflows.title: Housing vacancy, affordability and neighborhoods
workflows.test: Compare the same geography across releases. Ask for the boundary vintage, margin of error and denominator before turning a change in vacancy or rent burden into a trend.

workflows.title: Geology, natural resources and well records
workflows.test: Request the geological map scale and the location accuracy of nearby well logs. Check how the provider distinguishes conditions logged at a well from site-specific borings.

workflows.title: Outage history and road closures
workflows.test: Use a known disruption date and an exact site entrance. Check the reporting footprint, outage observation time and road restriction segment before treating a nearby event as a site impact.

providers.name: U.S. DOT Work Zone Data Exchange

workflows.title: Disaster losses and aggregated claims
workflows.test: For the same storm, ask which losses and insurance lines each source reports. Require the program, extraction date and geographic resolution before comparing totals.

workflows.title: Trade flows, ports and freight demand
workflows.test: Give both sources the same origin, destination, commodity and year. Ask whether they provide domestic estimates or reported shipments, and whether the units are value, weight or containers.

workflows.title: Historical parcel boundaries and change events
workflows.test: Replay Brooklyn tax lot 3039470001 on both sides of a split. Require both geometries, the change event and the date of each source edition, even where the retained parcel kept its ID.
